test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some boy are strong.

II. No strong is weak.

**Conclusion:**

I. All strong are boy.

II. All weak are boy.

III. All weak are strong.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follows
Both conclusions II and III follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6115db57d183cba46d374bc924613639e4ccadc4a54256a019b3f1c616e67a63.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All strong are boy → False (Some boy are strong so, All strong are boy is false)

II. All weak are boy → False (Some boy are strong and No strong is weak so, All weak are boy is false)

III. All weak are strong → False (No strong is weak so, All weak are strong is false)

∴ Here, All three conclusions are false.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion follows".**
